stories.title: Rare periods of low PV generation can be managed with storage
stories.description: The German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin) says that batteries could help manage shortfalls in solar and wind generation, while underground storage of green hydrogen could provide backup during prolonged periods of low renewable output.

stories.title: Spain could reach 10 GW of batteries by 2030, but bankability remains the major challenge
stories.description: The hybridization of solar PV plants, the evolution of arbitrage and ancillary services revenues, the future capacity market, and the financing of energy storage projects were the focus of a roundtable organized by pv magazine at Genera 2026.

stories.title: The Download: Better bionic hands and AI’s natural-gas boom
stories.description: This is today’s edition of The Download, our weekday newsletter that provides a daily dose of what’s going on in the world of technology. The next generation of bionic hands is here—and they can feel Avi Davidson lost his left hand as a teenager. Since then, he’s cycled through a few prosthetics.

stories.title: Draining peatlands is responsible for a few percent of our global warming
stories.description: Detailed estimate going back to 1800 shows how much carbon is being liberated.

stories.title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next week amid IPO uncertainty
stories.description: Flipkart's product and technology chief Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the company alongside its board until a successor is found.

stories.title: The questions Jensen Huang and Nvidia will still have to answer about Megaspeed
stories.description: The central question for investigators is what Nvidia knew about where those chips ended up and whether Huang's affair with a Megaspeed executive gave the company reason to doubt Megaspeed's assurances.

stories.title: Trump's accounts traded Nvidia shares 44 times this year, records show
stories.description: A review of the US president's financial disclosures shows Donald Trump's investment portfolios have regularly traded shares in the tech giant.

stories.title: Seven injured, four critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
stories.description: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, as officials urged residents to leave the area.

stories.title: Does Research-Paper Context Improve LLM-Generated Quadruped Navigation? An Exploratory Simulation Study
stories.description: arXiv:2611.32381v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large language models can write competent robot navigation code, but not only does the research on the topic advance, a model may also, due to the volume of findings, fail to recall relevant findings and apply them to the task at hand.

stories.title: Pramana: A Composable, Domain-Specific Backend for Empirical Networking Research
stories.description: arXiv:2607.26352v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Empirical networking research often tests a hypothesis with data the study itself generates, so accelerating this research requires shortening the time from forming a hypothesis to generating that data. Consider whether a bulk BBR download fairly shares its bottleneck with a Google Meet call.

stories.title: Estonian solar park energized with 55 MW/250 MWh battery
stories.description: Project developers say the battery energy storage system, which is tied to a 77.5 MW solar farm operational from 2024, features the Baltics’ largest battery system by storage capacity to date.

stories.title: This 345-million-year-old fossil had scientists fooled for decades
stories.description: A famous 345-million-year-old fossil has turned out to be something entirely different from what scientists believed for decades. Advanced X-ray imaging revealed hidden gills and thousands of tiny teeth, exposing a primitive aquatic or amphibious creature rather than an early reptile.
